Type 1 Rezoning Narrative —- 5701 N. Oriole Ave.

The Property

The property commonly referred to as: 5701 N. Oriole Ave, Chicago, IL 60631 with a
Grid Index Number of 15-0 on Zoning Map Page 20B, is a single-family home with a
detached 2 car garage in a “city-suburban” neighborhood surrounded by similar single
family homes. The proposed land in question (roughly 89.91’ x 75.80’ corner lot) shall
remain the residence of property owner Brendan Madden, and his family. The building
found on the property will remain the same height at roughly 24’ tall, with a working area of
146sqft in front of the original structure. There will be no private off street parking
additions. There currently stands a 2-car garage in the southeast corner of the property,
with no additions or modifications proposed.

The Project

The Applicant is seeking to improve the property with the addition of a front porch to
the existing structure. To allow for the proposed, a variation per 17-13-1101-B to reduce the
front setback (off N. Oriole Ave.) from 20.24’ to 15.00’ is requested. In doing so the
applicant also requests to rezone the current property from RS2 to RS2 Type 1. The setback
adjustment requested, also included in the ordinance page provided in part by Patrick
Murphey, is a point located 46.56 feet north of W. Higgins Ave, extending east and
perpendicular to N. Oriole Ave; a line 89.91 feet east of and parallel to N. Oriole Ave, W.
Higgins Ave, and N. Oriole Avenue.
